set.body:
Source: PRD.html sections 11 and 14 and requirements F-17 and F-18.

Scope:
- Resolve portable resource intent through explicit site profiles covering account, partition, QoS, memory convention, constraints, modules, containers, accelerators, limits, and native options.
- Record requested and effective resource specifications and keep preflight advisory.
- Lower compatible workloads into job arrays while preserving per-element attempt identity, logs, cancellation, outcome, and result contract.
- Measure coalesced observer behavior and controller-call bounds under realistic job counts.
- Establish fixtures for at least two supported Slurm major-release families and run a real unprivileged site acceptance campaign.
- Pilot slurmrestd behind Scheduler[F] only after CLI parity; keep the pilot non-gating if the site does not expose REST or parity does not justify the dependency.

Acceptance:
- Site policy rejects invalid memory/topology/resource combinations without claiming controller certainty.
- Array element failure never aliases another element.
- Observation remains bounded and avoids one RPC loop per job.
- Real-site evidence records exact versions, capabilities, commands, policy assumptions, and limitations.
set.title: P5: Add site profiles, arrays, scale evidence, and optional REST parity
